title: Making a Convincing Case
text:
An argumentative essay tries to persuade the reader that a claim is true. Writers usually begin with a clear thesis and then support it with evidence, such as facts, statistics, or expert opinions. A strong essay also considers counterarguments, which makes the writer appear fair and well informed.

However, many students forget to answer the opposing views. When they ignore these objections, readers may feel that the argument is one-sided and therefore less convincing. For this reason, a good conclusion should summarize the main points and explain why the thesis still stands.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do writers usually begin with?
According to the second paragraph, how do readers feel when a writer ignores opposing views?
Why does considering counterarguments make a writer appear fair?
options: It shows the writer has examined other viewpoints.
It proves the thesis is always correct.
It removes the need for evidence.

questions.text: What can be inferred about the purpose of a conclusion in an argumentative essay?
options: It should restate the main points and reinforce the thesis.
It should introduce a brand-new argument.
It should avoid mentioning the thesis.
It should repeat only the opposing views.

vocabulary.definition: to make someone believe or agree with something
facts or information that support a claim
showing only one point of view

paragraph_translations: Esej argumentacyjny próbuje przekonać czytelnika, że dana teza jest prawdziwa. Autorzy zwykle zaczynają od jasnej tezy, a następnie wspierają ją dowodami, takimi jak fakty, statystyki lub opinie ekspertów. Dobry esej uwzględnia także kontrargumenty, dzięki czemu autor wydaje się uczciwy i dobrze poinformowany.

Jednak wielu studentów zapomina odpowiedzieć na przeciwne poglądy. Gdy ignorują te zarzuty, czytelnicy mogą uznać argument za jednostronny, a więc mniej przekonujący. Z tego powodu dobre zakończenie powinno podsumować główne punkty i wyjaśnić, dlaczego teza nadal jest aktualna.
